key_facts.value_en: 2013-03-29 (the name first appeared on the Haval CUV, launched June 2005)
key_facts.value_zh: 2013 年 3 月 29 日（品牌名最早用于 2005 年 6 月上市的哈弗 CUV）
长城汽车股份有限公司
河北省保定市（与母公司同址）
民营（民营车企旗下品牌）

key_facts.value_en: Wei Jianjun (founder and chairman of Great Wall Motor)
key_facts.value_zh: 魏建军（长城汽车创始人、董事长）

key_facts.value_en: Not separately listed; part of Great Wall Motor (SSE 601633 / HKEX 02333)
key_facts.value_zh: 未单独上市；属长城汽车（上交所 601633 / 港交所 02333）

history.event_en: The Haval CUV goes on full sale in June (it had rolled off the line in March 2005), marking the birth of the Haval series; the Haval name appears for the first time.
history.event_zh: 哈弗 CUV 于 6 月全面上市（同年 3 月下线），标志着哈弗系列的诞生，「哈弗」名称首次出现。

history.event_en: The Haval H6 is launched, opening the brand's mainstream urban SUV era and later becoming its long-time best-seller.
history.event_zh: 哈弗 H6 上市，开启品牌主流城市 SUV 时代，此后成为品牌长期销量支柱。

history.event_en: Haval becomes an independent brand with its own logo, entering a dual-brand era alongside the Great Wall brand.
history.event_zh: 哈弗品牌正式独立，拥有独立标识，进入哈弗与长城双品牌时代。

history.event_en: The Haval H9 is launched at RMB 229,800-272,800, the brand's first high-end body-on-frame off-road SUV.
history.event_zh: 哈弗 H9 上市（22.98 万-27.28 万元），为品牌首款高端非承载式越野 SUV。

history.event_en: Haval publishes the Red Label / Blue Label two-line product strategy at the Shanghai Auto Show, splitting the line-up into red- and blue-badged networks.
history.event_zh: 哈弗在上海车展发布「红蓝标」双产品线战略，将产品与销售网络拆分为红标、蓝标两线。

history.event_en: Haval reaches an annual sales peak of 938,000 vehicles (+41.59% YoY); the H6 sells 580,683 units (+55.58%) and leads China's SUV market in monthly sales for 45 consecutive months through December 2016.
history.event_zh: 哈弗年销量达到峰值 93.80 万辆（同比 +41.59%）；H6 年销 580,683 辆（+55.58%），截至 2016 年 12 月连续 45 个月居中国 SUV 单月销冠。

history.event_en: Haval launches the F-series (F5 in September 2018), aimed at younger consumers; the F-series adopts the black badge from August 2018.
history.event_zh: 哈弗推出面向年轻用户的 F 系列（F5 于 2018 年 9 月上市）；F 系自 2018 年 8 月起采用黑色标识。

history.event_en: At the Haval 5-million-vehicle celebration, chairman Wei Jianjun announces the 5-2-1 globalisation strategy: 2 million vehicles a year within five years and becoming the world's number one professional SUV brand. By end-2018 Haval had led China's SUV market for nine consecutive years.
history.event_zh: 哈弗 500 万辆盛典举行，董事长魏建军发布「5-2-1」全球化战略：5 年内实现年销 200 万辆、成为全球专业 SUV 第一品牌。截至 2018 年末，哈弗已连续 9 年蝉联中国 SUV 销量第一。

history.event_en: With the launch of the H7/H7L, the black badge officially replaces the Red Label / Blue Label scheme, ending the red-blue strategy.
history.event_zh: 随着 H7/H7L 上市，黑标正式取代红蓝双标，红蓝标策略落幕。

history.event_en: Great Wall Motor's Tula plant in Russia, its first full-process overseas vehicle plant, is completed and starts production, with the Haval F7 as the first model off the line.
history.event_zh: 长城汽车俄罗斯图拉工厂竣工投产（海外首个全工艺整车厂），首台下线车型为哈弗 F7。

history.event_en: The Haval Big Dog (Dago) is launched, positioned as a city SUV with off-road capability and opening the brand's boxy universal off-road segment.
history.event_zh: 哈弗大狗上市，定位兼具越野性能的城市 SUV，开启品牌方盒子泛越野品类。

history.event_en: GWM's Rayong plant in Thailand starts production, with the first Haval H6 HEV rolling off the line; it is GWM's second full-process overseas vehicle plant.
history.event_zh: 长城汽车泰国罗勇工厂投产，首台哈弗 H6 HEV 下线，为长城汽车第二家海外全工艺整车厂。

history.event_en: At the Haval new-energy strategy conference, a new Haval brand logo is unveiled and the third-generation H6 DHT opens pre-sale.
history.event_zh: 哈弗新能源战略发布会举行，全新哈弗品牌标识正式亮相，第三代 H6 DHT 开启预售。

history.event_en: The Haval Raptor (Menglong) is launched from RMB 165,800, a boxy plug-in-hybrid SUV marketed as a mass-market new-energy off-road model.
history.event_zh: 哈弗猛龙上市（16.58 万元起），为方盒子插混 SUV，定位新能源越野普及者。

history.event_en: Zhao Yongpo is appointed Haval brand general manager.
history.event_zh: 赵永坡出任哈弗品牌总经理。

history.event_en: The new-generation Haval H6 is launched at RMB 117,900-143,900 (limited-time price from RMB 103,900); Great Wall Motor says the model has surpassed 4 million cumulative global sales.
history.event_zh: 新一代哈弗 H6 上市（11.79 万-14.39 万元，限时优惠后 10.39 万-12.99 万元）；长城汽车称该车型全球累计销量已超 400 万辆。

history.event_en: The second-generation Haval H9 is launched.
history.event_zh: 二代哈弗 H9 上市。

history.event_en: GWM's Iracemapolis plant in Brazil is completed and starts production, with the Haval H6 GT as the first model off the line; the plant has an initial annual capacity of 50,000 vehicles.
history.event_zh: 长城汽车巴西伊拉塞马波利斯工厂竣工投产，首台下线车型为哈弗 H6 GT；工厂初期年产能 5 万辆。

history.event_en: The Haval H6L, a mid-size urban SUV, is launched at a suggested retail price from RMB 117,900 (limited-time price from RMB 103,900).
history.event_zh: 哈弗 H6L 中型都市 SUV 上市，建议零售价 11.79 万元起（限时权益价 10.39 万元起）。

history.event_en: Zhao Yongpo is transferred to WEY (Wei brand) CEO and no longer heads Haval.
history.event_zh: 赵永坡接任魏牌 CEO，不再负责哈弗品牌。

history.event_en: Lu Wenbin is appointed Haval-ORA brand general manager of GWM's marketing centre, overseeing both the Haval and ORA brands.
history.event_zh: 吕文斌出任长城汽车营销中心哈弗欧拉品牌总经理，统管哈弗、欧拉两大品牌。

history.event_en: The GWM H10, a large boxy 5/6-seat SUV, is launched at a suggested retail price of RMB 209,800-231,800 (limited-time from RMB 201,800). It is the first model to use the GWM mother-brand name, chosen by a public vote of about 700,000 netizens.
history.event_zh: 长城 H10 大型方盒子 5/6 座 SUV 上市，建议零售价 20.98 万-23.18 万元（限时换新价 20.18 万元起），为长城旗下首款采用「长城」母品牌命名的车型（命名由约 70 万网友投票确定）。

brands.name_en: H6 series (incl. new-generation H6, H6L, H6 Classic)
brands.name_zh: H6 系列（含新一代 H6、H6L、H6 经典版）
brands.role_en: Compact-to-mid-size urban SUV, the brand's long-time flagship and best-seller.
brands.role_zh: 紧凑型至中型城市 SUV，品牌长期旗舰与销量支柱。
brands.price_band: 新一代 H6 11.79 万-14.39 万元（2024-06-19 上市，限时 10.39 万-12.99 万元）；H6L 建议零售价 11.79 万元起（2025-11-18 上市，限时 10.39 万元起）。New-generation H6 RMB 117,900-143,900 (launched 2024-06-19, limited-time RMB 103,900-129,900); H6L suggested retail from RMB 117,900 (launched 2025-11-18, limited-time from RMB 103,900).
brands.owner_note_en: Launched in August 2011. Per China Economic Net, the H6 led China's SUV market in monthly sales for 108 consecutive months before being overtaken by the BYD Song and Tesla Model Y in 2022 and slipping to sixth in 2023. Great Wall Motor said the model had surpassed 4 million cumulative global sales at the new-generation launch in June 2024. The new-generation H6 (June 2024) and H6L (November 2025) extended the series.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2011 年 8 月上市。据中国经济网，H6 曾连续 108 个月蝉联 SUV 销量第一，2022 年被比亚迪宋、特斯拉 Model Y 超越，2023 年排名第六。长城汽车在 2024 年 6 月新一代车型上市时称其全球累计销量已超 400 万辆。新一代 H6（2024 年 6 月）、H6L（2025 年 11 月）延续该系列。

brands.role_en: 3/4-scale boxy urban crossover, positioned in the universal off-road segment.
brands.role_zh: 「3/4 刻度」方盒子城市越野 SUV，定位泛越野品类。
brands.price_band: 官网在售哈弗大狗 PLUS、大狗 2026 款、大狗 PLUS PHEV；哈弗官网快讯载长城大狗混动版限时优惠换新价 10.59 万元起（2026-09-28）。Haval website lists Dargo PLUS, Dargo 2026 and Dargo PLUS PHEV; a Haval news item records the Dargo hybrid limited-time trade-in price from RMB 105,900 (2026-09-28).
brands.owner_note_en: Launched in September 2020. Per the 2025 annual report, the Dargo series sold 180,201 vehicles in 2025 (+18.13% YoY), leading the boxy and universal off-road SUV segment. The current website lists the Dargo under both Haval and GWM (Great Wall) naming.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2020 年 9 月上市。据 2025 年年报，大狗品类 2025 年累计销量 180,201 辆（同比 +18.13%），持续引领方盒子与泛越野 SUV 赛道。官网目前在售车型中既有「长城大狗」亦有「哈弗大狗 PLUS」命名。

brands.role_en: Boxy compact SUV offered in both plug-in hybrid and fuel versions.
brands.role_zh: 方盒子紧凑型 SUV，提供插混与燃油双动力版本。
brands.price_band: 猛龙上市价 16.58 万元起（2023-10-10）；官网另有长城猛龙 PLUS 力魂版限时优惠换新价 18.48 万元起（2026-09-23）。Raptor launch price from RMB 165,800 (2023-10-10); the website also lists the Raptor PLUS Lihun edition limited-time trade-in price from RMB 184,800 (2026-09-23).
brands.owner_note_en: Launched in October 2023. Per the 2025 annual report, the Raptor achieved 2025 sales of 89,304 vehicles (+33.84% YoY), topping the three-year resale value list for plug-in hybrids. The current website lists the Raptor PLUS under the GWM name.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2023 年 10 月上市。据 2025 年年报，猛龙 2025 年销售 89,304 辆（同比 +33.84%），登顶插电混动车型三年保值率榜。官网目前在售的猛龙 PLUS 采用「长城」母品牌命名。

brands.name_zh: 枭龙 MAX（二代枭龙 MAX）
brands.role_en: Mid-size SUV with intelligent electric four-wheel-drive hybrid (Hi4).
brands.price_band: 官网在售二代哈弗枭龙 MAX（2025-04-16 上市）。Second-generation Xiaolong MAX listed on the website (launched 2025-04-16).
brands.owner_note_en: The second-generation Xiaolong MAX was launched on 16 April 2025 per GWM's official history; the 2025 annual report describes it as using a stylish design plus Hi4 technology for precise market positioning.
brands.owner_note_zh: 据长城汽车官网发展历程，二代哈弗枭龙 MAX 于 2025 年 4 月 16 日上市；2025 年年报称其以时尚造型 + Hi4 技术实现精准市场定位。

brands.role_en: Full-size body-on-frame off-road SUV, the brand's off-road flagship.
brands.role_zh: 大型非承载式越野 SUV，品牌越野旗舰。
brands.price_band: 官网在售二代哈弗 H9 2026 款；哈弗官网快讯载长城 H9 力魂版限时优惠换新价 21.49 万元起（2026-08-24）。Second-generation H9 2026 listed on the website; a Haval news item records the H9 Lihun edition limited-time trade-in price from RMB 214,900 (2026-08-24).
brands.owner_note_en: First launched in November 2014 at RMB 229,800-272,800. The second-generation H9 was launched on 25 September 2024. Per GWM's official history, the second-generation H9 diesel took a top-three result in the T2.1 mass-production fuel class at the 2025 Taklimakan Rally, and chairman Wei Jianjun drove the second-generation H9 diesel in the 2025 China Rally Championship Jinta stage.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2014 年 11 月首发（22.98 万-27.28 万元）。二代 H9 于 2024 年 9 月 25 日上市。据长城汽车官网发展历程，二代 H9 柴油版在 2025 环塔国际拉力赛获 T2.1 量产燃油组前三名，董事长魏建军驾驶二代 H9 柴油版参加 2025 中国汽车越野拉力锦标赛金塔分站赛并顺利完赛。

brands.price_band: 官网在售新哈弗 H5。New H5 listed on the website.
brands.owner_note_en: The new-generation H5 was relaunched in 2023 as a full-size multi-purpose SUV.
brands.owner_note_zh: 新哈弗 H5 于 2023 年焕新上市，定位大型全用途 SUV。

brands.role_en: Large boxy 5/6-seat family SUV, the first model to carry the GWM mother-brand name.
brands.role_zh: 大型方盒子 5/6 座家庭 SUV，首款采用「长城」母品牌命名的车型。
brands.price_band: 建议零售价 20.98 万-23.18 万元，限时换新价 20.18 万元起（2026-08-05 上市）。Suggested retail RMB 209,800-231,800, limited-time trade-in price from RMB 201,800 (launched 2026-08-05).
brands.owner_note_en: Launched 5 August 2026 with four configurations and 5/6-seat layouts. Its name was chosen by a public vote of about 700,000 netizens, making it the first GWM model to use the mother-brand name; its front still carries the HAVAL badge. It uses the second-generation Hi4 performance hybrid and Coffee Pilot 3 with lidar as standard, with a 42.8 kWh battery (CLTC pure-electric range 232 km, combined 1,404 km). Great Wall Motor reported 31,826 firm orders within 24 hours of launch.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2026 年 8 月 5 日上市，共 4 款配置、5/6 座布局，命名由约 70 万网友投票确定，为长城旗下首款采用「长城」母品牌命名的车型，前脸仍挂 HAVAL 标识。搭载第二代 Hi4 性能版电混四驱、标配激光雷达的 Coffee Pilot 3 智驾系统，42.8 kWh 电池（CLTC 纯电续航 232 公里、综合续航 1404 公里）。长城汽车称上市 24 小时大定突破 31,826 台。

brands.name_en: F-series / M6 / Shenshou / Chitu / Chulian (JOLION) and other earlier models
brands.name_zh: F 系列 / M6 / 神兽 / 赤兔 / 初恋（JOLION）等早期车型
brands.role_en: Earlier series and compact SUVs; several have been discontinued in China while some continue as export models.
brands.role_zh: 早期系列与紧凑型 SUV；部分已在国内停售，部分以出口车型延续。
brands.owner_note_en: The F-series (F5, F7, from 2018), M6 (launched January 2021 as M6 PLUS), Chitu (launched May 2021) and Chulian (launched January 2021, exported as JOLION) were launched in earlier years. Per GWM's official history, the JOLION went on sale in South Africa in April 2021 and the JOLION HEV debuted in Bangkok in November 2021. Their current in-sale status is not separately confirmed from primary disclosures.
brands.owner_note_zh: F 系列（F5、F7，2018 年起）、M6（2021 年 1 月 M6 PLUS 上市）、赤兔（2021 年 5 月上市）、初恋（2021 年 1 月上市，海外名 JOLION）为早年投放车型。据长城汽车官网发展历程，JOLION 于 2021 年 4 月在南非上市、2021 年 11 月 JOLION HEV 在泰国曼谷首发。以上车型当前在售状态未从一手披露单独核实。

financials.standard: Not separately disclosed (Haval is a brand of Great Wall Motor)
financials.note_en: Haval is an SUV brand of Great Wall Motor and does not publish separate financial statements (revenue, gross margin, net profit, R&D or cash flow) for the brand, so no brand-level figures are listed and financials.rows is empty. For reference, the parent Great Wall Motor reports under PRC GAAP (Chinese Accounting Standards), and its net profit is net profit attributable to shareholders of the listed company, i.e. attributable to shareholders of the parent; it is not net profit attributable to ordinary shareholders in the IFRS sense. Great Wall Motor's own multi-year financial table is in the Great Wall Motor (gwm) deep research. This page does not constitute any trading recommendation.
financials.note_zh: 哈弗为长城汽车旗下 SUV 品牌，未单独披露品牌层面的财务数据（营收、毛利率、净利润、研发投入、现金流等），故本表 financials.rows 为空数组，不列财务数字。供参考：母公司长城汽车按中国企业会计准则（PRC GAAP）编制报表，其净利润为「归属于上市公司股东的净利润」（即归属于母公司股东的净利润），并非 IFRS 口径下的「归属于普通股股东净利润」；长城汽车自身的多年财务表见长城汽车（gwm）深度研究。本页不构成任何交易推荐。

overview.en:
Haval is the core SUV brand of Great Wall Motor Company Limited, positioned as a global SUV specialist. The name first appeared on the Great Wall Haval CUV, which rolled off the line in March 2005 and went on full sale in June 2005; on 29 March 2013 Haval became an independent brand with its own logo, entering a dual-brand era alongside the Great Wall brand.[s2][s26][s9] Haval is one of Great Wall Motor's vehicle brands, alongside WEY, Tank, ORA, Great Wall Pickup, Great Wall Soul and Great Wall Commercial Vehicle, and is the largest of them by passenger-vehicle volume.[s1]

In 2025 Haval sold 761,487 vehicles (+7.69% year on year), and by year-end its cumulative global users surpassed 10 million, per the Great Wall Motor 2025 annual report.[s1] Per the June 2026 production and sales brief, Haval sold 327,290 vehicles in the first half of 2026 (+1.82% year on year), with June sales of 60,288 vehicles (-3.38% year on year).[s3] Per the September 2026 brief, Haval sold 66,558 vehicles in September 2026 (-18.76% year on year) and 515,080 vehicles in January-September 2026 (-2.54% year on year).[s22][s8]

Per the 2025 annual report, Haval rests on three core technologies, the Hi4 intelligent electric-hybrid four-wheel-drive, the Coffee OS 3 smart cockpit and the Coffee Pilot Plus advanced driving-assistance system, and covers three segments: mainstream urban, universal off-road and off-road.[s1] From 2026 some models have adopted the GWM mother-brand name (the GWM H10 and others), while the brand keeps its global-SUV-specialist positioning.[s4][s13]

The brand's best-known model is the H6, launched in August 2011. Per China Economic Net, the H6 led China's SUV market in monthly sales for 108 consecutive months, was overtaken by the BYD Song and Tesla Model Y in 2022 and ranked sixth in 2023, and had surpassed 4 million cumulative global sales by the June 2024 new-generation launch.[s12][s7] The 2025 annual report records 2025 sales of 89,304 vehicles for the Raptor (+33.84%) and 180,201 for the Dargo series (+18.13%).[s1]
overview.zh:
哈弗（Haval）是长城汽车股份有限公司的核心 SUV 品牌，定位「全球 SUV 专家」。品牌名最早用于 2005 年 3 月下线、6 月全面上市的长城哈弗 CUV，2013 年 3 月 29 日作为独立品牌运营，拥有独立标识，进入哈弗与长城双品牌时代。[s2][s26][s9] 哈弗是长城汽车旗下整车品牌之一，与魏牌、坦克、欧拉、长城皮卡、长城灵魂、长城商用车等并列，也是其中乘用车销量规模最大的品牌。[s1]

据长城汽车 2025 年年度报告，哈弗 2025 年销售 761,487 辆（同比 +7.69%），截至年末全球累计用户突破 1000 万。[s1] 据公司 2026 年 6 月产销快报，哈弗 2026 年上半年销售 327,290 辆（同比 +1.82%），其中 6 月销售 60,288 辆（同比 -3.38%）。[s3] 据公司 2026 年 9 月产销快报，哈弗 2026 年 9 月销售 66,558 辆（同比 -18.76%），1-9 月累计销售 515,080 辆（同比 -2.54%）。[s22][s8]

据 2025 年年报，哈弗依托 Hi4 智能电混四驱、Coffee OS 3 智能座舱、Coffee Pilot Plus 高阶智驾三大核心技术，布局主流都市、泛越野、越野三大品类。[s1] 2026 年起部分车型改用「长城」母品牌命名（长城 H10 等），品牌仍保持「全球 SUV 专家」定位。[s4][s13]

品牌最知名的车型为 2011 年 8 月上市的哈弗 H6。据中国经济网，H6 曾连续 108 个月蝉联 SUV 销量第一，2022 年被比亚迪宋、特斯拉 Model Y 超越，2023 年排名第六；至 2024 年 6 月新一代车型上市时全球累计销量已超 400 万辆。[s12][s7] 2025 年年报载明猛龙年销 89,304 辆（同比 +33.84%）、大狗品类 180,201 辆（同比 +18.13%）。[s1]

current.en:
Model line-up

As of the research cut-off date, the Haval China website lists a new-energy line-up (GWM H10, GWM Raptor PLUS, Dargo PLUS PHEV, Raptor 2026, second-generation Xiaolong MAX) and a fuel/HEV line-up (GWM Dargo, second-generation H9 2026, H6L, Dargo PLUS, Raptor fuel, new H5, new-generation H6, H6 Classic 2026).[s4] The new-generation H6 launched on 19 June 2024 at RMB 117,900-143,900 (limited-time RMB 103,900-129,900), and the H6L launched on 18 November 2025 at a suggested retail price from RMB 117,900 with a limited-time price from RMB 103,900.[s12][s17] The Raptor launched from RMB 165,800 in October 2023, while the GWM H10, launched 5 August 2026 at RMB 209,800-231,800, is the top of the range.[s21][s15]

Positioning evolution and GWM mother-brand naming

The brand evolved from a mainstream SUV specialist into a three-segment structure. Per the 2025 annual report, Haval covers mainstream urban, universal off-road and off-road segments with a full-category, full-scenario, multi-powertrain matrix, and upholds the brand values of focus, technology, reassurance and an enterprising spirit.[s1] Media reported that after Lu Wenbin took charge of Haval in May 2026 he started a naming-adjustment plan, and that the H10, whose name was chosen by a public vote of about 700,000 netizens, is the first GWM model to use the mother-brand name while its front still carries the HAVAL badge.[s13] Historically Haval split into Red Label and Blue Label sub-brands from 2015, and the black badge replaced the red-blue scheme in March 2019.[s23]

Product cadence

GWM's official history records a steady cadence of Haval launches: the second-generation H9 (25 September 2024), the second-generation Xiaolong MAX (16 April 2025), the Dargo 2026 (17 July 2025), the H6L (18 November 2025), the Raptor PLUS (15 May 2026) and the H10 (5 August 2026).[s2] The Dargo (September 2020) opened the boxy universal off-road segment and the Raptor (October 2023) extended it into plug-in-hybrid new-energy off-road.[s19][s21]

Technology and platforms

Per the 2025 annual report, Haval is built on the Hi4 intelligent electric-hybrid four-wheel-drive (with the Hi4 2.0 upgrade), the Coffee OS 3 smart cockpit and the Coffee Pilot Plus advanced driving-assistance system, and uses the Guiyuan (GWM ONE) platform to expand its new-energy range.[s1] The H10 uses the second-generation Hi4 performance hybrid and Coffee Pilot 3 with lidar as standard.[s15] As of the cut-off date, the website line-up contains no pure-electric model, only fuel, HEV and plug-in-hybrid variants.[s4]

Plants and capacity

Haval is produced in Great Wall Motor's plants at home and abroad. GWM's Tula plant in Russia (completed 5 June 2019) was its first full-process overseas plant, the Rayong plant in Thailand (started 9 June 2021) was its second, and the Iracemapolis plant in Brazil (completed 16 August 2025, initial capacity 50,000 vehicles a year) is its third full-process overseas base, with the Haval H6 GT as the first model off the line.[s2][s20] A KD plant in Pakistan began assembly in September 2022 with the third-generation Haval H6.[s2]

Overseas business

Haval is Great Wall Motor's main export brand. GWM sold 453,141 vehicles overseas in 2024 (+43.39% year on year) and 506,066 in 2025 (+11.68%).[s2] Russia is the largest single market; per Phoenix Auto, GWM sold about 229,800 vehicles there in 2024 (about 12% local share and nearly half of its overseas volume), while in the first half of 2025 the Russian passenger-car market shrank 27.6% and Haval's Russia sales fell to about 64,000 vehicles (-21.5%).[s25] Brazil is growing, with the Iracemapolis plant targeting South America.[s20]
current.zh:
车型谱系

截至研究截止日，哈弗中国官网列示新能源车型（长城 H10、长城猛龙 PLUS、大狗 PLUS PHEV、猛龙 2026 款、二代枭龙 MAX）与燃油/HEV 车型（长城大狗、二代 H9 2026 款、H6L、大狗 PLUS、猛龙燃油版、新 H5、新一代 H6、H6 经典版 2026 款）。[s4] 新一代 H6 于 2024 年 6 月 19 日上市（11.79 万-14.39 万元，限时 10.39 万-12.99 万元）；H6L 于 2025 年 11 月 18 日上市，建议零售价 11.79 万元起、限时权益价 10.39 万元起。[s12][s17] 猛龙 2023 年 10 月上市（16.58 万元起）；长城 H10 于 2026 年 8 月 5 日上市（20.98 万-23.18 万元），为品牌最高价位车型。[s21][s15]

定位演变与「长城」母品牌命名

品牌定位由主流 SUV 专家演化为三大品类结构。据 2025 年年报，哈弗布局主流都市、泛越野、越野三大品类，构建全品类、全场景、多动力产品矩阵，并践行「专注、科技、安心、进取」品牌价值。[s1] 据媒体报道，吕文斌 2026 年 5 月接管哈弗后启动命名调整计划；H10 的命名由约 70 万网友投票确定，为长城旗下首款采用「长城」母品牌命名的车型，其前脸仍挂 HAVAL 标识。[s13] 历史上哈弗还曾于 2015 年起拆分红标、蓝标两大子品牌，2019 年 3 月黑标取代红蓝双标。[s23]

产品投放节奏

长城汽车官网发展历程记录了哈弗稳定的投放节奏：二代 H9（2024 年 9 月 25 日）、二代枭龙 MAX（2025 年 4 月 16 日）、大狗 2026 款（2025 年 7 月 17 日）、H6L（2025 年 11 月 18 日）、猛龙 PLUS（2026 年 5 月 15 日）、长城 H10（2026 年 8 月 5 日）。[s2] 2020 年 9 月大狗上市开启方盒子泛越野品类，2023 年 10 月猛龙上市将这一品类延伸至插混新能源越野领域。[s19][s21]

技术与平台

据 2025 年年报，哈弗依托 Hi4 智能电混四驱（含 Hi4 2.0 升级）、Coffee OS 3 智能座舱、Coffee Pilot Plus 高阶智驾，并借助归元平台拓展新能源产品。[s1] 长城 H10 搭载第二代 Hi4 性能版电混四驱，标配激光雷达的 Coffee Pilot 3 智驾系统。[s15] 截至截止日，官网在售车型均为燃油、HEV 或插混，无纯电车型。[s4]

工厂与产能

哈弗在国内外的长城汽车工厂生产。俄罗斯图拉工厂（2019 年 6 月 5 日竣工投产）为长城首个海外全工艺整车厂，泰国罗勇工厂（2021 年 6 月 9 日投产）为第二个，巴西伊拉塞马波利斯工厂（2025 年 8 月 16 日竣工投产，初期年产能 5 万辆）为第三个海外全工艺整车基地，首台下线车型为哈弗 H6 GT。[s2][s20] 2022 年 9 月巴基斯坦 KD 工厂投产，首台当地组装第三代哈弗 H6 下线。[s2]

海外业务

哈弗是长城汽车海外主力品牌。长城汽车 2024 年海外销售 453,141 辆（同比 +43.39%）、2025 年海外销售 506,066 辆（同比 +11.68%）。[s2] 俄罗斯是最大单一市场；据凤凰网汽车，长城 2024 年在俄销量约 22.98 万辆（当地份额约 12%、贡献海外销量近半），2025 年上半年俄罗斯乘用车市场萎缩 27.6%、哈弗在俄销量降至约 6.4 万辆（同比 -21.5%）。[s25] 巴西市场增长较快，伊拉塞马波利斯工厂面向整个南美市场。[s20]

leadership.en:
Brand ownership and governance

Haval is not a separate listed company; it is a brand operated within Great Wall Motor. Per the 2025 annual report, Great Wall Motor's actual controller is Wei Jianjun, its founder and chairman. Wei Jianjun joined the predecessor business as general manager in 1990 and has chaired the joint-stock company since June 2001.[s1][s2]

Current brand head

According to media reports, Lu Wenbin was appointed Haval-ORA brand general manager of GWM's marketing centre in May 2026, overseeing both the Haval and ORA brands. Lu Wenbin was born in 1983, joined Great Wall Motor in 2004 and worked long-term in technology and R&D, having served as pickup product director, deputy general manager of the Chongqing branch and the Yongchuan production base, and Haval brand technical general manager; he became ORA brand general manager on 20 June 2025.[s11][s13]

Previous brand general manager

Zhao Yongpo was appointed Haval brand general manager in November 2023; GWM's chief growth officer Li Ruifeng described him as a technology veteran of over 20 years who was formerly deputy general manager of the GWM technology centre, leading vehicle platform, lower body, performance and chassis development.[s10] On 8 February 2025 Zhao announced he would also manage the ORA brand, and on 21 December 2025 he was transferred to WEY (Wei brand) CEO, no longer heading Haval.[s24][s27] The above are all public roles and commercial history.
leadership.zh:
品牌归属与治理

哈弗并非单独上市公司，而是长城汽车旗下品牌。据 2025 年年报，长城汽车实际控制人为创始人、董事长魏建军；魏建军 1990 年加入公司前身并担任总经理，2001 年 6 月起任股份公司董事长。[s1][s2]

现任品牌负责人

据媒体报道，吕文斌于 2026 年 5 月出任长城汽车营销中心哈弗欧拉品牌总经理，统管哈弗、欧拉两大品牌。吕文斌 1983 年出生，2004 年加入长城汽车，长期从事技术与研发工作，历任皮卡产品总监、重庆分公司副总经理、永川生产基地副总经理、哈弗品牌技术总经理等职；2025 年 6 月 20 日起任欧拉品牌总经理。[s11][s13]

上一任品牌总经理

赵永坡于 2023 年 11 月出任哈弗品牌总经理，长城汽车首席增长官（CGO）李瑞峰称其深耕技术领域 20 年、曾担任长城汽车技术中心副总经理，主导整车平台、下车体、性能和底盘研发等工作。[s10] 2025 年 2 月 8 日赵永坡宣布同时负责欧拉品牌；2025 年 12 月 21 日调任魏牌 CEO，不再负责哈弗品牌。[s24][s27] 以上均为公开职务与商业履历。

competition.en:
Our judgment: competitive scope. Based on Haval's compact-to-full-size SUV line-up, the main domestic competitors are BYD (Song series), Geely, Changan (CS75 series) and Chery, which overlap in the mainstream and boxy SUV segments. In the off-road segment it faces the Tank brand within its own group and rivals such as Chery's JETOUR and JAECOO and BYD's Fang Cheng Bao. The GWM H10, a large boxy 5/6-seat SUV launched at RMB 209,800-231,800, enters the 200,000-yuan large family SUV segment, overlapping with new-energy rivals in the same class. This is our analytical selection, not a sales ranking.[s4][s16][s15]

Our judgment: strengths. Haval retains a large installed base (over 10 million cumulative users by end-2025), a long H6 sales record, and a differentiated boxy/off-road line-up (Dargo 180,201 and Raptor 89,304 vehicles in 2025). The 2025 annual report records the Raptor topping the three-year resale value list for plug-in hybrids, and GWM's history records the second-generation H9 taking a top-three result in the T2.1 mass-production fuel class at the 2025 Taklimakan Rally. It also benefits from Great Wall Motor's overseas plants and network, where Haval is the main export brand.[s1][s2]

Our judgment: weaknesses and uncertainties. The H6, once the brand's anchor, led China's SUV market for 108 consecutive months before being overtaken by the BYD Song and Tesla Model Y in 2022 and falling to sixth in 2023; the brand's annual sales remain well below the 2016 peak of about 938,000. Its electrified mix is limited and, as of the cut-off date, the line-up has no pure-electric model. Its reliance on the Russian market concentrates overseas risk, and the shift of some models to the GWM mother-brand name is still in transition.[s12][s16][s25][s13]
competition.zh:
我们的判断：竞争范围。按哈弗紧凑型至全尺寸 SUV 的产品线，国内主要竞争对手为比亚迪（宋系列）、吉利、长安（CS75 系列）、奇瑞等，在主流与方盒子 SUV 细分市场存在重叠；越野细分市场则面对同集团的坦克品牌及奇瑞捷途、奇瑞 JAECOO、比亚迪方程豹等。长城 H10 以 20.98 万-23.18 万元切入 20 万级大型家庭 SUV 市场，与同级新能源车型存在价格重叠。此为分析所选的竞争范围，不是销量排名。[s4][s16][s15]

我们的判断：优势。哈弗保有庞大存量用户（截至 2025 年末累计超 1000 万）、长期的 H6 销量纪录，以及差异化的方盒子/越野产品线（2025 年大狗 180,201 辆、猛龙 89,304 辆）。2025 年年报载明猛龙登顶插电混动车型三年保值率榜首；长城汽车官网发展历程载明二代 H9 柴油版获 2025 环塔拉力赛 T2.1 量产燃油组前三名。同时哈弗受益于长城汽车海外工厂与渠道，是集团海外主力品牌。[s1][s2]

我们的判断：短板与不确定性。H6 曾连续 108 个月蝉联 SUV 销量第一，2022 年被比亚迪宋、特斯拉 Model Y 超越，2023 年排名第六；品牌年销量仍明显低于 2016 年约 93.80 万辆的峰值。品牌电动化结构有限，截至截止日在售车型无纯电产品；对俄罗斯市场的依赖集中了海外风险；部分车型向「长城」母品牌命名的切换仍在过渡中。[s12][s16][s25][s13]

outlook.en:
Company plans. The 2025 annual report states that Haval will deepen its global footprint, accelerate the deployment of Hi4 technology and the all-scenario adaptation of intelligent driving assistance, and use the Guiyuan (GWM ONE) platform to expand the new-energy market, aiming for growth in both sales volume and value.[s1] Media reported that, at the 2025 Guangzhou Auto Show, Zhao Yongpo said the brand would use its best technology to build a GWM flagship large six-seat SUV, which materialised as the GWM H10 launched in August 2026.[s13][s14] Media also reported that Great Wall Motor set a 2026 group sales target of at least 1.8 million vehicles (1.2 million domestic plus 600,000 overseas), versus about 1.3237 million in 2025, with Haval as the core volume brand.[s13][s2] These are disclosed directions and targets, not completed results.

Our judgment. The H10 and the GWM mother-brand naming give the brand a higher-price flagship and a clearer group-level identity; the H10's reported 31,826 firm orders in 24 hours indicate strong initial demand, but this is an order figure, not sustained sales.[s14][s15] Whether the brand can restore scale and improve its electrified mix depends on continued demand for the H10 and boxy models, execution of the naming transition, and overseas conditions such as Russia demand and trade barriers. First-half 2026 sales grew only 1.82% year on year, so a return to the 2016 peak is not yet in evidence.[s3] The 5-2-1 target announced in January 2019 (2 million vehicles a year within five years) was not met: actual sales were 706,234 vehicles in 2024 and 761,487 in 2025.[s9][s6][s1]
outlook.zh:
公司公开规划。2025 年年报称，哈弗将深化全球化布局，加速 Hi4 技术输出与智驾辅助全域适配，依托归元平台拓展新能源市场，实现销量与价值双增长。[s1] 据媒体报道，赵永坡在 2025 广州车展曾表示将用哈弗最好的技术打造长城旗舰大型六座 SUV，即 2026 年 8 月上市的长城 H10。[s13][s14] 据媒体报道，长城汽车 2026 年集团销量目标为不低于 180 万辆（国内 120 万辆、海外 60 万辆），较 2025 年约 132.37 万辆有所上调，哈弗为核心走量品牌。[s13][s2] 以上为公司披露的方向与目标，不是已实现的业绩。

我们的判断。H10 与「长城」母品牌命名，为品牌带来更高价位的旗舰产品与更清晰的集团级身份；H10 上市 24 小时大定 31,826 台显示初始需求较强，但这只是订单数字，不等于持续销量。[s14][s15] 品牌能否恢复规模并改善电动化结构，取决于 H10 及方盒子车型的持续需求、命名切换的执行，以及俄罗斯需求、贸易壁垒等海外环境。2026 年上半年销量同比仅 +1.82%，回归 2016 年峰值尚无数据支撑。[s3] 2019 年 1 月提出的「5-2-1」目标（5 年内年销 200 万辆）并未实现：实际销量 2024 年 706,234 辆、2025 年 761,487 辆。[s9][s6][s1]

risks.en:
• Domestic competition. China's SUV market is highly competitive and price-driven; media reported that the H6 lost its monthly sales lead after 108 months and was overtaken by the BYD Song and Tesla Model Y in 2022.[s12]
  • Electrification mix. As of the cut-off date, Haval's line-up contains no pure-electric model, which weighs on its sales structure as China's new-energy penetration rises.[s4]
  • H6 dependence and decline. The H6, the brand's long-time anchor, has declined from its 2016 peak of 580,683 units; a continued fall would pressure the whole brand.[s16][s12]
  • Overseas concentration. Haval depends heavily on the Russian market; per media reports, Russia contributed nearly half of GWM's overseas volume in 2024, and in the first half of 2025 the Russian market shrank and Haval's Russia sales fell about 21.5%, while trade barriers rose.[s25]
  • No separate financial disclosure. Haval does not publish brand-level revenue or profit, so standalone profitability cannot be assessed from public filings.[s1]
  • Management transition and renaming. The brand head changed from Zhao Yongpo to Lu Wenbin between December 2025 and May 2026, alongside a naming adjustment that shifts some models to the GWM mother-brand name, adding execution uncertainty.[s27][s11][s13]
risks.zh:
• 国内竞争。中国 SUV 市场竞争激烈、价格敏感；据媒体报道，H6 在连续 108 个月销冠后失去月销冠，2022 年被比亚迪宋、特斯拉 Model Y 超越。[s12]
  • 电动化结构。截至截止日，哈弗在售车型无纯电产品，在中国新能源渗透率持续提升的环境下对销量结构形成压力。[s4]
  • 对 H6 的依赖与下滑。H6 由 2016 年 580,683 辆的峰值回落；若继续下滑将拖累整个品牌。[s16][s12]
  • 海外集中风险。哈弗高度依赖俄罗斯市场；据媒体报道，俄罗斯 2024 年贡献长城海外销量近半，2025 年上半年当地市场萎缩、哈弗在俄销量同比下滑约 21.5%，且贸易壁垒上升。[s25]
  • 无单独财务披露。哈弗未披露品牌层面营收与利润，无法从公开文件评估品牌独立盈利能力。[s1]
  • 管理层交接与命名切换。2025 年 12 月至 2026 年 5 月，品牌负责人由赵永坡更替为吕文斌，并伴随部分车型向「长城」母品牌命名的调整，带来执行层面的不确定性。[s27][s11][s13]
